reading: How the assertions of one field become one status. Ordered rules, first match wins, exceptions on top. The pack never decides which source prevails: when current sources disagree, every value is shown side by side with its source, date and edition. A value is shown as fact only when every current source could be read and they all agree; otherwise the field is [TO CONFIRM] and what could be read is listed as a statement, not as a fact.

event_supersedes_earlier_state.note: A later event document (deed, resolution, transfer, appointment, office transfer) makes every earlier value of the field historical. What an event document proves against a registry extract is a legal question: the pack only orders documents by date.

later_edition_supersedes_same_series.note: Within one series of state documents (registry extracts, holders' ledger, the financial summary of one year) only the latest edition is a current witness; earlier editions are history.

same_day_state_is_current.note: A state document dated on the same day as the latest event is treated as current: if it differs, the difference is shown rather than assumed away.

adjudication.note: No source is preferred. A human adjudicates.

unread_document_blocks_fact.note: A document of the entity that could not be classified (unknown type, broken header) may change any field. If it is not older than the latest event document of a field - or has no valid date, or the field has no event document - the field is [TO CONFIRM]. Added after the first stress run (eval/history.json, run 2).

unreadable_current_source_blocks_fact.note: When one current source of a field could not be read, the value of the other current sources is not shown as fact: the unread source may disagree. Added after the first stress run (eval/history.json, run 2).

rules.reason: a document of the entity could not be read and may change this field
rules.rationale: Exception on top of everything: a document that was not classified is not evidence of absence. If it is not older than the latest event document of the field, nothing is shown as fact for that field.

rules.reason: no current source for this field
rules.rationale: Nothing to show: the field is written [TO CONFIRM], never filled.
Exception above every single-value rule: current sources disagree. Every value is kept with its sources; none is chosen.

rules.reason: a current source of this field could not be read
rules.rationale: The latest event document or a current witness is unreadable for this field. An older value is history and is never promoted back; the value of the other current sources is listed as a statement, not shown as fact, because the unread source may disagree.
Every readable current source gives the same value. It is shown once, with the latest source first and the others listed.

outgoing_scan.reading: Scanner for outgoing documents that still carry a superseded value. Ordered guards, first match wins, exceptions on top; the default flags the line.

rules.rationale: A document written before the change carried the value that was current on its own date.

rules.rationale: The same amount without the cue of the field (an invoice, a guarantee) is another figure.

tests.text: Invoice to Fornace Aurelia S.r.l., total EUR 50.000,00

rules.rationale: The line itself presents the amount as a past value.

tests.text: Until the increase the share capital of Fornace Aurelia was EUR 50.000,00.

rules.rationale: The nearest entity named is not the entity whose value was superseded.

tests.text: Holding Aurelia Partecipazioni S.r.l. - share capital EUR 50.000,00

rules.rationale: No mention of the entity in the line or in the lines just above.

tests.text: The share capital amounts to EUR 50.000,00.

rules.rationale: Default: the superseded amount is presented as current for this entity.
